decisions.reason: The battery JST placement and orientation do not change the specified electrical or thermal battery-protection behavior.
The NTC remains connected through J_BAT; changing the connector's physical placement and orientation does not alter the temperature-sensing method.
The battery-connector arrangement is owned by the battery-interface Requirement and does not alter the existing board dimensions, mounting, USB-edge, or enclosure-fit constraints.
The source concerns the battery JST and board JST, not the USB-C connector or its sourceability.
The physical arrangement of the battery and board JST connectors does not change charge-status indication through the main-board LED chain.
The connector placement decision does not change boost-converter enable control, pull-down configuration, or powered-load behavior.
The source specifies connector placement and orientation without changing the TVS-based ESD-protection requirement.
Nothing in the source changes I2C cable length, clock speed, pull-up resistance, or pull-up location; the meaning of 'board JST' is insufficient to infer an electrical-bus change.
The source changes only the battery connector's physical arrangement and makes no component-selection or availability decision.
